note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: Does the boiler lack O2 trim or three-element drum level control?

evidence.text: equipment F-A reads "F-A Fired unit A"

where: DCS/PLC configuration: combustion and drum level configuration
data_requests.how: Note O2 trim and level control elements.

questions.decision_rule: Worth an upgrade where O2 trim or feed/steam flow in the level loop is missing on a large boiler.

typical_benefit.wording: LBNL boiler table (as reported in LBNL-56183): "Improved Process Control 3%", 0.6 yr payback.
source_titles: S19: Worrell & Galitsky, Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for Petroleum Refineries: An ENERGY STAR Guide (LBNL-56183, Feb 2005)
